build_vit_base_model: build a ViT-B/16 VisionTransformer model with 768 embed dim and 12 transformer blocks
build_vit_small_model: build a ViT-S/16 VisionTransformer model with 384 embed dim and 6 attention heads
extract_self_attention_maps: extract self-attention maps from the last transformer block of a VisionTransformer model
extract_intermediate_layer_features: extract normalized output tokens from the last N transformer blocks of a VisionTransformer
build_dino_head_classifier: build a DINOHead MLP classifier with bottleneck dimension and weight-normalized last layer
